comment: Artifacts fetched at build time. Every entry is pinned by SHA-256, so a
build either reproduces exactly what was measured or fails loudly.
The ONNX Runtime Web distribution is not listed here: it is a locked npm
devDependency and the build copies it out of node_modules, which makes it
reproducible through package-lock.json without a second hash list.

backbone.source: Xenova/clip-vit-base-patch32, an ONNX export of openai/clip-vit-base-patch32
